body.message:
Here's the full breakdown:

June, July, August at AED 5,000/month. To secure the dates: AED 10,000 upfront (first + last month) plus AED 1,500 refundable deposit, then months 2 and 3 paid as you go.

For the employer advance letter, just send over your passport copy and email and we can get the lease agreement drafted for you to submit to HR. Shall I get that started?
